1. Mateo -- you're attaching the deployment audit records now and will cross-reference them against Leah's three regulated customers once she posts the list. Report back as soon as the cross-reference is complete so we know exactly which customer environments were touched.

2. Leah -- please post the customer list and clause details to the incident channel now. Once Mateo confirms the cross-reference, I'll own coordinating and tracking the customer notifications. We'll calculate the exact 24-hour window from the exposure timestamp to determine our remaining time.

3. Hana -- please update the incident checklist with the 400-day immutable retention requirement now, and once Mateo confirms which records are in-scope, verify that both the build log system and the deployment audit system can enforce immutable retention for those specific records.

I'm formally extending this incident review past 4 PM. We will not close until all three items are confirmed complete. I'll take responsibility for tracking the overall closure checklist and will keep the incident channel updated as each item is resolved. Please flag any blockers immediately.
